question: Related Questions Q. Tawaf 2781 views Q. Is it permissible to perform Hajj or Umrah on behalf of two or more people in one Hajj or Umrah? 12129 views Q. I then went next day to Medina to visit Masjid e Nabuwi and on returning I did not intend to do Umrah again and returned from Medina to Makaah without Ihram. Have I committed a mistake? and if yes what should I do as now I am back in Bombay. Please advice urgently. 4118 views Q. My parents are planning to go for Haj (insha-allah). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 168407 Country: Bangladesh Title: Hajj Question: I would like to perform Hajj. But I have no money in cash and property. I am a college teacher and I have a Provident Fund. I can take some money for Hajj from that fund. Is it mandatory for me to take money from that fund for Hajj. Answer ID: 168407 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 490/441/SD=06/1440) If you are authorized to withdraw money from your PF and you have as much amount in your PF which can fulfill the expenses of Hajj along with your necessities of life then it is fardh on you to withdraw the amount from your PF and perform hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
